baseline.definition: With the feature gate off, the replay pin tests/golden/replay_pin.json reproduces byte for byte.

conventions: A case is: given this state, when this one command or trusted event is applied, then this result and state.

A command is the game's envelope {type, command_id, state_revision, params}. For a hero command state_revision is hero.revision; for a run command (StartRun, ChooseUpgrade, SetActionPlan) it is the engine's run revision.
given.history lists earlier steps in order, each with its outcome; they are applied to the given state before 'when'. An 'aborted' step failed inside its transaction and was rolled back.
A hero has a mastery row (rank 1, 0 points) for every unlocked vocation unless the case says otherwise. 'run': null means the profile has no unfinished run (v0.1 phase PARTY_SETUP).
then.state is partial: only what is listed is asserted. Entries of a list are matched by their id (hero_id, vocation_id, item_id, die_instance_id).

These lists are complete, not partial: unlocked_vocations, equipped_skills, item_consumptions, quests_completed, mastery_award_events, run_die_upgrades, processed_commands and then.events (which is also ordered).
claim_event 'events[0]' means the event_id of the first event in then.events.
A rejected result changes nothing: no row, no revision, no random draw. error_code and denial_reason values come from docs/class_evolution/persistence/error_codes.json.
then.duplicate true is the replay result of the registry: accepted, the stored result returned, no second effect.
Vocation, skill, item, quest, die and encounter ids are those of the v0.1 vocation catalog. Catalog version, rules and RNG are the baseline's.
A case with needs_design_decision gives the best structured form available; the sentence says what must be decided before it can become a test.

cases.title: MVP feature gate

invariants: Squire, Apprentice and Scout stats, starting dice, enemy AI, reactions and rerolls are those of content 1.3.1.
No progression state is read while the gate is off.

cases.notes: Baseline: With the feature gate off, the replay pin tests/golden/replay_pin.json reproduces byte for byte. Today tests/integration/test_replay_logs.py checks the pin. Decided by the owner on 2026-11-11: the gate is a launch setting, off by default (--feature class_evolution_v1 or the environment variable BATTLE_DICE_FEATURES); it is not in any content file, so the content hash cannot move; while it is off the vocation catalog is not loaded and the progression database is not opened. tests/unit/test_vocations.py checks that the catalog module is never loaded with the gate off.

cases.title: Global discovery is not eligibility
cases.notes: v0.1 named the reason MISSING_MASTERY(squire,8); it is PREREQUISITE_UNMET with the vocation and rank in the details. A preview is a pure read: it is accepted and reports why a claim would be rejected.

cases.title: Hero alternate quest route
cases.notes: route_1 is the second alternative of the Hero prerequisite: three mastered advanced vocations and the Trial of the Hero. Neither Champion nor Archmage is unlocked.

cases.title: Hero cannot bypass all routes
cases.notes: v0.1 said 'two advanced rank 8' together with Archmage at rank 7. Archmage cannot be unlocked without mastering Arcanist and Shadowbinder, so this state has four mastered advanced vocations; the second route still fails because the Trial is not complete.

cases.title: Hidden UI state no leakage

forbidden_strings: A crooked reflection hides an unlikely profession.

cases.needs_design_decision: The career-tree view model does not exist yet: its shape, and whether a hidden secret vocation shows as an anonymous placeholder or not at all, must be decided.

cases.title: Secret clue progression
cases.notes: The other authored signal, quest_hint:crooked_mirror, leads to 'hinted': the clue text is shown and the prerequisite stays hidden. Decided by the owner on 2026-11-11: discovery only moves forward (hidden, hinted, discovered); a weaker signal after a stronger one changes nothing, and clue_count counts each distinct signal once.

cases.title: Other heroes require own tokens
cases.notes: Discovery is shared by the profile; the token is paid per hero.

cases.title: Cheapest satisfied OR route
cases.notes: Both routes are satisfied. route_0 (Scout mastered and Crooked Mirror complete) consumes nothing, so it is chosen before route_1 (Apprentice mastered and one jester_mask).

cases.title: Retain cross-vocation rank
cases.notes: No run is active, which is the v0.1 phase PARTY_SETUP. Mastery is never reset or halved by a switch.

cases.title: Battle-time switch illegal
cases.notes: v0.1 'phase=combat' is the engine phase 'battle'.

cases.title: One active vocation only
cases.notes: Duelist is unlocked for this hero, so the only reason for the rejection is the second slot.

cases.title: New class dice eligibility
cases.needs_design_decision: Die compatibility is not defined beyond the per-die affinity_tags of the catalog; the fixture assumes a die fits only a vocation named in its tags, which sends both Squire dice to the bench.

cases.title: Legacy mandatory upgrade stays equipped
cases.notes: ChooseUpgrade, its parameters and the offer id format are the shipped ones. The shipped engine already moves to 'equipment' after the upgrade and refuses to swap out the upgraded die. Decided by the owner on 2026-11-11: inside a run a hero may change vocation after recovery and before the mandatory upgrade (engine phase 'upgrade', before ChooseUpgrade), so the upgrade cards are offered for the new vocation's dice. Changing is also allowed at party setup, and never during a battle or after the upgrade.

cases.title: One mastery base per eligible victory
cases.notes: Guardian at rank 1 needs threat 2; rank 2 starts at 2 points.

cases.title: Rank advances after bonus
cases.notes: The Squire challenge protect_ally was met once.

cases.title: Challenge spam does not farm
cases.notes: protect_ally was met eight times in the encounter; the bonus is still one point and the total two.

cases.title: Threat cap gives exactly zero
cases.notes: Champion at rank 7 needs threat 5; the encounter has 3. The challenge was met and still earns nothing.

cases.title: No mastery on defeat or flee
cases.notes: Decided by the owner on 2026-11-11: a lost encounter records a mastery award row with 0 points and the reason ENCOUNTER_NOT_WON. Flee stays out until the engine has such an outcome.

cases.title: Earlier victory persists after later loss
cases.needs_design_decision: Whether 'run-only upgrade removed' means the run_die_upgrade rows are deleted at run end or kept as history and no longer applied; the fixture assumes they are kept and stop applying once the run is complete.

cases.title: Mastery bonus caps
cases.notes: Squire base stats are the shipped 1.3.1 values: 14 HP, 3 mana, 7 speed, initiative 5. Squire and Guardian each give +1 HP, Apprentice and Arcanist each ask for +1 mana; the mana cap is 1.

cases.title: Budget reject atomicity
cases.notes: v0.1 placed this case on Guardian. Field Medic is Guardian's own skill and costs no capacity while Guardian is active (FDD 6.4), so the total there would be 3, not 6. Spellblade has the same capacity 4 and a Healing face for Field Medic.

cases.title: Learned is not executable

invariants: The hero has no Healing action in combat: the skill adds no face and no action.

cases.notes: Neither Duelist die has a Healing face. Decided by the owner on 2026-11-11: equipping a face-modifier skill with no eligible face is rejected with NO_LEGAL_FACE; the skill stays learned and nothing changes.

cases.title: Insufficient mana is a trap not loss

invariants: The downed hero is not revived.
The skill stays learned and equipped.

cases.needs_design_decision: No authored vocation has max_mana 0 and the shipped engine rejects action plans with free text, not codes; the catalog override used here and the code or reason for a face that is disabled for lack of mana must be decided.

cases.title: Revival tags are mandatory

invariants: Squire Rally and Apprentice Mend can still target a downed hero when their resource and target conditions are met.

cases.needs_design_decision: The shipped engine rejects an illegal action plan with free text and no code, so whether this rejection gets a registry code, and which, must be decided.

cases.title: Reaction stages unchanged
cases.needs_design_decision: Duelist's native reaction (rx_duelist_parry, interrupt stage) is authored in the catalog only and has no engine effect yet, so the exact event list of this case cannot be pinned until that effect is defined.

cases.title: Deterministic stream preservation
cases.needs_design_decision: The recorded command sequence, the canonical encoding of progression events and the fields left out of every hash (wall-clock timestamps) must be fixed before this case can name expected hash values.

cases.title: Idempotent claim and reward
cases.notes: cmd-ce33-1 was accepted when the hero's revision was 9. Sent again unchanged it returns the stored result; its old state_revision is not a conflict. The repeated award for the same run, encounter, hero and vocation is acknowledged in the same way.

invariants: No row of the save is changed or deleted.
No vocation is substituted for another.

cases.title: Party configuration unchanged

invariants: Every party of the matrix starts a run.
Every combatant has exactly one active vocation.
Two heroes of one party may have the same active vocation.

cases.needs_design_decision: How Class Evolution heroes enter the shipped StartRun party parameter (class ids today, hero ids with build snapshots later) is undecided; the fixture lists the party matrix and sends the shipped command for the five-hero party.

cases.title: Progression threat reachability
cases.needs_design_decision: The shipped game has two fixed battles and no threat ratings, so which encounters count as available, and their ratings, must be authored before the validator can run on real content.
cases.notes: With only training_01 to training_03 the highest threat is 3. Other ranks fail on this pool as well; the case names the one v0.1 used.

cases.title: No class unlock for guest
cases.notes: v0.1 named the code CHARACTER_NOT_ELIGIBLE. The guest meets the item route (Apprentice mastered, one jester_mask), so its guest state is the only reason for the rejection.

cases.title: Transactional rollback
cases.notes: The first attempt fails inside the transaction and is rolled back: it is neither accepted nor rejected and its command id is not recorded. The same command id then succeeds once.

cases.title: Class changes after recovery

invariants: current' = ceil(current * new_max / old_max), clamped to 0..new_max.
A hero at 0 HP stays at 0 HP and downed: the conversion never revives.
Corruption is kept, capped at the new maximum.

cases.notes: Squire 14 HP (1.3.1) and Guardian 17 HP (v0.1 catalog), each +1 for the mastered Squire. 8 * 18 / 15 = 9.6, rounded up to 10. Decided by the owner on 2026-11-11: a vocation change inside a run happens after recovery (see CE-19), so the hero is standing when it changes. The conversion rule still never revives: a hero at 0 HP would stay at 0 HP and downed.

cases.title: MVP speed and action rules stable

invariants: Action scheduling, rerolls, two-row targeting, seed streams and terminal priority are those of the baseline.

cases.needs_design_decision: Whether a fresh profile with the gate on must reproduce the pin exactly, final_state_hash included (assumed here), or only its combat events, since that hash changes as soon as any progression field joins the engine state.
cases.notes: Baseline: With the feature gate off, the replay pin tests/golden/replay_pin.json reproduces byte for byte. Here the gate is on and every hero is a novice with a default build and no mastery bonus.
